cohort: 111 nulliparous women at term with unengaged fetal head
finding: A high station at the onset of labor in nulliparous women is not necessarily an ominous finding, although the incidence of arrest disorders is higher when the station is -3 or floating.
mod_finding: 71.71% of nulliparous women with unengaged fetal head had a normal vaginal delivery, 10.8% had an instrumental delivery, and 18.2% underwent a cesarean section.
